_note_currency: KNOWN DATA ISSUE: the SKU summary table prices are in AUD, but each per-SKU detail page prices the same SKU in USD. Numbers below are copied as-is from each source. Confirm real currency with product/pricing team before quoting a customer.

skus.positioning: Flagship. Top sensory scores (umami, sweetness, aroma, water solubility). Use when the buyer explicitly wants top-tier ceremonial quality and price is secondary.
Engineered specifically for milk-based drinks (matcha latte). Water solubility 5/5. Use when the lead's stated use case is a latte menu.
Cost-optimized while still 100% Uji ichibancha ceremonial grade. DEFAULT RECOMMENDATION when the lead explicitly asks for both premium/Kyoto quality AND wholesale price competitiveness.
Best price-to-flavor benchmark; nutty/milky profile. Use for volume-focused buyers who are open to non-Kyoto origin, or for multi-origin trial sample sets.
Lowest cost, vivid color at volume. Use for large-volume / cost-sensitive buyers, RTD beverage, ice cream, or bakery use cases.

differentiators: Every SKU US FDA pesticide/contaminant tested
Flexible MOQ from 20kg per SKU, no minimum-container commitment

sample_request.turnaround: curated sample box + cupping notes + quote sheet within 2 business days
